visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair wearing a black tank top is seated on a light beige sofa indoors. Beside him sits a brown and white Shiba Inu dog looking directly at him. The setting has soft indoor lighting and a neutral wall background. The man is speaking and gesturing with his hands. (2) The man leans slightly toward the dog and mimics a barking sound, opening his mouth wide. The dog remains seated and attentive with its ears perked up. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) The man barks twice in quick succession. The Shiba Inu responds by opening its mouth and barking twice back at him. The man maintains eye contact and a playful facial expression throughout the interaction. (4) The man barks three times. The dog waits for him to finish and then produces three distinct barks in response. The camera remains static, capturing the medium shot of both the man and the dog. (5) The man looks surprised and delighted, forming an 'O' shape with his mouth, while the dog continues to sit calmly on the sofa. A variety-style text overlay appears near the dog's head.
